newsitem.title: USA: Travelers to sell products through brokers.
newsitem.headline: Travelers to sell products through brokers.

text.p: Travelers Life and Annuity Co said on Tuesday it has formed a unit to sell retirement plans and asset management through broker/dealers and financial planners.

Travelers Portfolio Group will oversee the distribution of a portfolio of financial products that cover life insurance for the retirement and estate planning markets, annuities, long-term care insurance, and savings programs, the Travelers Group Inc unit said.
Stuart Baritz, a senior vice president at Travelers, will serve as chairman and chief executive of Travelers Portfolio Group, while Michael Kiley will serve as president.
Kiley, who will also serve as national sales manager for the unit, had most recently served in a similar position at Equitable Cos Inc, Travelers said.
